title: I went to the Renaissance fair and got a lesson in belonging
gist: Evening Edition teaser about a visit to the Maryland Renaissance Festival and the idea that unserious places can be among the most important for belonging. Only a brief excerpt is available.

insights.claim: Seemingly unserious communal venues such as the Renaissance fair may be among the most important places for people's sense of belonging.
insights.speaker: Halina Bennet
insights.so_what: Supports the thesis that in-person communal events are a social-capital and experience-economy tailwind.
insights.quote: Maybe the least serious places are some of the most important.
